title: Pic Of Drake & Friends Resurfaced After Kanye West Shared That Suns' Chris Paul Allegedly Hooked Up With Kim Kardashian
htmlContent:
During a Thursday night tweet storm that saw him share an image of a swastika, seemingly announcing his candidacy for president and taking photos on Twitter CEO Elon Musk. Kanye West stated that he "caught" the future Hall of Famer and Suns guard Chris Paul with his ex-wife Kim Kardashian.

West and Kardashian were married for eight years, beginning in 2014 and ending with a high-profile divorce earlier this year. Paul, 37, has been in the NBA since 2005 and is considered one of the largest players in the league's history.

The Thursday evening West Tweets series came after a shocking appearance on Alex Jones' discredited and misinformed InfoWars program that saw the 45-year-old father defend four others and support the Nazis, saying he "sees some good things about Hitler" and wants people to "stop dissing the Nazis all the time."

Speaking of Ye, a photo of Drake and friends in Chris Paul Jerseys resurfaced after his latest outburst on Twitter, which ended with Elon Musk suspending his account.

According to Akademiks, the photo was originally posted as promotions for Drake album Certified Lover Boy.

As for Chris Paul, he has been dealing with a heel injury.

“Chris, he’s close,” said Suns president of basketball operations, James Jones, on Tuesday. “He’s coming back. He’ll be back. I can’t tell you he’ll be back (Wednesday). He’s been looking good and we’re still taking the long view with him. From Day 1, we’ve said that when our guys are eligible to play, when they’re available, they’re completely available. No restrictions. Nothing mentally, physically, to hold them back. So he’s getting there. And once he gets there, you’ll know.”
